stories.headline: Micron posts $54.2B quarter, guides $61.5B and says memory shortage tightens through 2028

key_facts.fact: Micron reported fiscal Q4 2026 revenue of $54.23 billion, up from $11.32 billion a year earlier, with GAAP net income of $37.70 billion ($32.87 per diluted share).
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue of $54.23 billion versus $41.46 billion for the prior quarter and $11.32 billion for the same period last year; GAAP net income of $37.70 billion, or $32.87 per diluted share

key_facts.fact: Results beat LSEG consensus: adjusted EPS $33.42 vs $31.61 expected; revenue $54.23B vs $51.07B expected.
key_facts.excerpt: Earnings per share: $33.42 adjusted vs. $31.61 expected; Revenue: $54.23 billion vs. $51.07 billion expected

key_facts.fact: Micron guided fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of $61.5 billion plus or minus $1.5 billion and non-GAAP gross margin of about 86.25%, versus analyst expectations of $57 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: For the fiscal first quarter, Micron said it expects revenue of about $61.5 billion and adjusted earnings per share of $38.15. Analysts polled by LSEG had expected $35.40 in adjusted earnings per share on $57 billion in revenue.

key_facts.fact: Fiscal 2026 revenue was a record $133.2 billion, up 256%, and DRAM revenue for the year surpassed $100 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: The company achieved record fiscal 2026 revenue of $133.2 billion, a 256% increase year over year... Micron's DRAM revenue for the fiscal year 2026 surpassed $100 billion.

key_facts.fact: CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said supply-demand will be tighter in 2027 and 2028 than in 2026 and that Micron has 'no line of sight' to when supply and demand rebalance; customers will pay 'much higher prices'.
key_facts.excerpt: "In fact, we see greater tightness in the industry in 2027 and in 2028 versus 2026. Overall, supply-demand environment is only getting tighter." "We do not have line of sight to when supply and demand will return to balance."

key_facts.fact: Micron said the vast majority of its calendar 2027 HBM supply is contracted at significantly higher prices, more than 75% of fiscal 2027 output is committed, and it is working with Nvidia on the first custom HBM4E (NV-HBM).
key_facts.excerpt: We have completed agreements for the vast majority of our calendar 2027 HBM bit supply with significant price increases year-over-year... More than 75% of fiscal 2027 output is already committed, and discussions for 2028 are underway.

key_facts.fact: Micron plans first-half fiscal 2027 capex of about $25 billion and is raising fiscal 2027 capex mainly to accelerate cleanroom space for late 2028 and beyond.
key_facts.excerpt: In fiscal Q1, we project CapEx of around $11.5 billion and anticipate first half fiscal 2027 CapEx to be approximately $25 billion.

stories.headline: FT: Tencent leases ~100,000 AI chips unavailable in China from Oracle in $7B deal

key_facts.fact: Tencent signed its largest overseas lease deal with Oracle to access about 100,000 advanced AI chips that are not available in China, the Financial Times reported on Sept. 30.
key_facts.excerpt: Tencent signed its largest overseas lease deal with US cloud provider Oracle to access about 100,000 advanced AI chips that were not available in China, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday

key_facts.fact: The five-year lease spans multiple Oracle data centers in Southeast Asia, is worth about $7 billion and carries an upfront payment of about 30%.
key_facts.excerpt: Tencent signed a US$7 billion, five-year lease with Oracle for 100,000 advanced AI chips not available in China... The deal covers multiple Oracle data centres in South-east Asia and includes an upfront payment of about 30%.

key_facts.fact: The chips are unavailable in China because of US export controls; the lease lets Tencent use them offshore to advance its AI models and agentic tools.
key_facts.excerpt: The lease will enable Tencent to access Oracle's GPUs in the data centers, which are not available in China due to the US' export controls on the hardware

key_facts.fact: The upfront payment weighed on Tencent's free cash flow in its second-quarter earnings.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal is worth $7 billion with upfront payment of about 30%, the FT report said, and weighed on Tencent's free cash flow in its second quarter earnings.

key_facts.fact: ByteDance and Alibaba remain the biggest clients of data centers in Southeast Asia.
key_facts.excerpt: While Tencent is keeping pace with multibillion-dollar leasing deals, ByteDance and Alibaba remain the biggest clients of data centers in south-east Asia.

stories.headline: Amazon signs 20-year, 690MW nuclear deal funding a 190MW uprate at Constellation's Calvert Cliffs

key_facts.fact: Constellation and Amazon announced on Sept. 30 a 20-year power purchase agreement covering 690 MW from the Calvert Cliffs nuclear plant in Maryland, including a 190 MW uprate.
key_facts.excerpt: The expansion of Calvert Cliffs' generating capacity will be supported by a 20-year agreement, which includes 690 megawatts of power, including the 190 megawatt uprate.

key_facts.fact: The deal enables more than $3 billion in Maryland infrastructure investment, with the new capacity coming online between 2030 and 2032 at the 1,790 MW plant.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement will enable more than $3 billion in Maryland infrastructure investment, including state-of-the-art improvements across the entire 1,790-megawatt plant and approximately 190 megawatts in total of new, emissions-free generating capacity coming online between 2030 and 2032.

key_facts.fact: Amazon's commitment gives Constellation revenue certainty to relicense the plant for another 20 years; its two reactors' licenses currently expire in 2034 and 2036.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon's long-term commitment will help provide Constellation with the revenue certainty to relicence the plant for another 20 years... which would otherwise shut down in 2034 and 2036.

key_facts.fact: Pricing was not disclosed; the parties also signed a retail supply agreement for Amazon operations in the 13-state PJM market.
key_facts.excerpt: The companies didn't provide pricing details, but said the deal will support more than $3 billion in investments in Maryland's energy infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: The power flows onto the regional grid rather than directly to Amazon data centers; Constellation will also evaluate small modular reactors at the site.
key_facts.excerpt: All of the power produced by the facility will still flow onto the regional grid for all customers to use... Constellation also said Wednesday that it plans to evaluate the possibility of new small modular nuclear reactors on the Calvert Cliffs site.

key_facts.fact: Amazon walked away last month from plans to build a data-center campus next to the plant after community opposition.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon.com walked away last month from plans to build a data-center campus next to a nuclear plant in Maryland after facing community opposition.

stories.headline: JERA, Dell and RHAELM plan $15B, 400MW AI data center beside a Chiba power plant

key_facts.fact: On Oct. 1, Japan's largest power generator JERA, Dell Technologies and UK-based RHAELM signed an MoU to build a standardized national-scale AI infrastructure model, starting with a project at JERA's Chiba Thermal Power Station.
key_facts.excerpt: JERA... Dell Technologies... and RHAELM Holdings Ltd., a sovereign AI infrastructure developer, today signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to develop a standardized framework for building AI infrastructure at national scale in Japan.

key_facts.fact: The Chiba project has up to 400 MW of power and total capital deployment expected to exceed $15 billion (2.3 trillion yen), with operations targeted around 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: Supported by power capacity of up to 400 MW... Total capital deployment of the Chiba Project is expected to exceed US $15 billion (2.3 trillion yen)... Operations are targeted to begin around 2028.

key_facts.fact: The site will be powered behind-the-meter from JERA's gas-fired plant, delivering capacity years ahead of a grid-connected schedule; JERA will supply 400 MW for 15-25 years.
key_facts.excerpt: JERA, jointly owned by Tokyo Electric Power and Chubu Electric Power, will supply 400 MW of power capacity for 15-25 years, while Dell will provide standardised, rack-scale AI infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: Apollo Global Management intends to be RHAELM's strategic investment and financing partner for the Chiba project.
key_facts.excerpt: The framework will initially be deployed at a project in Chiba, Japan, for which Apollo Global Management plans to serve as a strategic investment and financing partner for Rhaelm

key_facts.fact: The companies call it Japan's largest single-site AI infrastructure deployment and aim for multi-gigawatt capacity at other JERA sites in the 2030s.
key_facts.excerpt: At this scale, it would be the largest single-site AI infrastructure deployment in Japan... with the ambition of supporting multi-gigawatt-scale AI infrastructure capacity across Japan in the 2030s.

stories.headline: Volantis raises $88M to link AI chips to memory with iPhone-style lasers

key_facts.fact: San Francisco chip startup Volantis announced on Oct. 1 an $88 million Series A co-led by Lachy Groom and Abstract Ventures, with John Doerr, VXI Capital, Triatomic and Susa Ventures participating.
key_facts.excerpt: Volantis... today announced an $88 million Series A co-led by Lachy Groom and Abstract Ventures, with participation from John Doerr, VXI Capital, Triatomic and Susa Ventures. The round also includes angel investors Dwarkesh Patel, Naveen Rao and Sholto Douglas.

key_facts.fact: Volantis uses vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs), the lasers behind Face ID, to send data between compute and memory chips with light, aiming to pack 220 memory chips around a GPU versus eight HBM stacks on Nvidia's best current products.
key_facts.excerpt: even Nvidia's best current offerings can hold only eight of those memory chips for each of its graphics processing units... Volantis says it is developing a way to send data between computing chips and memory chips using beams of laser light... would let it pack 220 memory chips around a GPU.

key_facts.fact: Its first system, A-1, is designed to run models exceeding 20 trillion parameters at up to 10,000 tokens per second per user.
key_facts.excerpt: Its first system, A-1, is being designed to run models exceeding 20 trillion parameters at up to 10,000 tokens per second per user, while reducing inference cost per token.

key_facts.fact: The micro-VCSEL design avoids external lasers and indium phosphide supply constraints, with links under one picojoule per bit; the team includes veterans of Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom and Ayar Labs.
key_facts.excerpt: Its architecture uses custom micro-VCSELs rather than external lasers, drawing on the existing gallium arsenide VCSEL supply chain and avoiding indium phosphide supply constraints... enabling end-to-end links consuming less than one picojoule per bit.

key_facts.fact: Volantis is led by CEO Tapa Ghosh and will use the funds to develop and commercialize A-1 and expand engineering.
key_facts.excerpt: The company intends to use the funds to support the development and commercialization of A-1 and its photonic memory architecture, and expand its engineering team. Led by CEO Tapa Ghosh

stories.headline: Huawei says memory crunch added $200 per phone and plans more price hikes

key_facts.fact: Huawei consumer business chief Richard Yu said rising memory costs have raised Huawei's average smartphone cost by about $200, without specifying the comparison period.
key_facts.excerpt: The Chinese technology champion has seen an average increase of US$200 in its smartphone costs, according to Huawei's consumer business chief Richard Yu, though he did not specify a time frame for comparison.

key_facts.fact: Yu told reporters in Shenzhen: 'We'll have to raise prices going forward, though it will be moderate. It's hurting our profitability very badly.'
key_facts.excerpt: "We'll have to raise prices going forward, though it will be moderate," Yu told reporters in Shenzhen, home to Huawei, this week. "It's hurting our profitability very badly."

key_facts.fact: Yu argued the shortage favors premium makers; Counterpoint estimates some 230 million smartphones priced below $200 will disappear by the end of the decade.
key_facts.excerpt: Market research firm Counterpoint Research recently estimated that by 2030, approximately 230 million smartphones priced below $200 will disappear from the market.

key_facts.fact: Huawei's net profit fell 36% in the first half of 2026, partly due to stockpiling raw materials ahead of rising costs.
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei's net profit in the first half of this year fell by 36%. One contributing factor to the increased cost burden was the company's extensive stockpiling of raw materials in anticipation of rising costs.
